manifest.display_name: Project IRA action-diverse SO-101 visual world-model proof

intent.prediction_target: next pooled DINOv2 patch tokens, decoded RGB frame, and joint state
intent.purpose: test whether a larger action-diverse SO-101 slice improves action sensitivity on MPS

known_limitations: The 12-episode proof downloads two complete shared video chunks because LeRobot v3 packs ten episodes per member video; the enforced ceiling is 75 MB.
Only desk_view is used; wrist_left remains upstream and is not downloaded.
The two selected members improve motion diversity but do not represent all 46 tasks.
The 4x4 pooled patch grid and 64x64 decoder prioritize a bounded local proof over fidelity.
Remote provisioning remains plan-only until teardown tests pass.

intent.prediction_target: five-step open-loop 4x4 DINOv2 token grids and joint states
intent.purpose: isolate whether spatial token interaction improves the five-step visual world model

known_limitations: This recipe changes the predictor architecture and uses a 0.0001 learning rate after the transformer's residual-initialized predictor failed its smoke test at the MLP's 0.001 rate.
The five-step loss is discounted by 0.8 per predicted step and pixel supervision remains one-step so the experiment isolates open-loop latent/state training.
The first visual recipes use only the laptop camera and five episodes.
DINOv2 is not yet represented in either WarmHub registry; the official upstream artifact is pinned and the gap is recorded in discovery.json.
Ten-step evaluation extrapolates beyond the five-step training objective.
Rerun animates the five validated arm joints; the unmapped gripper remains at its URDF default.
Remote provisioning remains plan-only until teardown tests pass.
